'''N.J. Opuh''' was a [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] frequenter of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="FF54">{{FactFile|54|COR 23-26|Coruscant – Dex's Diner}}</ref> The Phuii visited while the diner was active no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] to its closure between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="DexEra">{{FactFile|54|COR 23-26|Coruscant – Dex's Diner}} states that [[Didi Oddo]] gave up his café four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which includes Jinn's death, to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Therefore, [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] must have owned the building some point during or after around [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]. ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]'' states that [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes was [[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the novel to around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]]. Therefore, Dex's Diner was destroyed between 19 BBY and 18 BBY.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
N.J. Opuh was set to appear in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="Dex"></ref> released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> Opuh would have reused the computer-generated model of the [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] character from<ref name="Dex">{{DB|location|dexsdiner|Dex's Diner}}</ref> the [[1999]] prequel trilogy<ref name="Year" /> film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Opuh was first mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Dex's Diner,<ref name="Dex" /> published on [[July 5]], 2002,<ref name="DBdate">{{SWArchive|url=databank/news/2002/07/news20020705.html|text=On the Hunter's Trail}}</ref> and later first [[Canon|canonically]] mentioned in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
